steps.label: mw_open
steps.text: Press the microwave door key with a nub; the door springs ajar; rise onto its pin and swing it open

steps.label: fridge_open
steps.text: Rise onto the outer door pin, break the seal, swing the door to the end of reach

steps.label: fridge_wide
steps.text: Inner pin on the door rack: swing the door on to 100 deg

steps.label: take
steps.text: Grip the jar at mid-height, lift 15 mm, out

steps.label: to_microwave
steps.text: Into the microwave, onto the turntable centre

steps.label: mw_close
steps.text: Swing the microwave door shut by its pin, press start

steps.label: fridge_close
steps.text: Inner pin swings the door back to about 45 deg, the outer pin shuts it

steps.label: heat
steps.text: Heat (sped up)

steps.label: mw_reopen
steps.text: Press the door key, swing the door open again

steps.label: take_hot
steps.text: Take the hot jar out

steps.label: serve
steps.text: Stand it on top of the microwave

steps.label: mw_shut
steps.text: Close the microwave door and park

steps.label: done
steps.text: Parked

steps.label: fridge_wide
steps.text: Inner pin on the door rack: swing the door on to 100 deg

steps.label: take
steps.text: Fork under the box on its rails, jaw onto the lid, lift 15 mm, out

steps.label: to_microwave
steps.text: Into the microwave: onto the ribs on the turntable

steps.label: mw_close
steps.text: Swing the microwave door shut by its pin, press start

steps.label: fridge_close
steps.text: Inner pin swings the door back to about 45 deg, the outer pin shuts it

steps.label: heat
steps.text: Heat (sped up). The Shelly cuts the power with the turntable at 0 or 180 deg

steps.label: mw_reopen
steps.text: Press the door key, swing the door open again

steps.label: take_hot
steps.text: Fork in along the ribs (turned 180 deg plus a few), take it out

steps.label: serve
steps.text: Set it on the serving ribs on top of the microwave

steps.label: mw_shut
steps.text: Close the microwave door and park

steps.label: done
steps.text: Parked
